# Nanodoc

> Nanodoc is a 100% free PDF editor that runs in the browser (nanodoc.app) or as a free desktop app for Mac and Windows. There is no paywall, no premium tier, no watermark, and no sign-up. All PDF processing happens locally on the user's device; files are never uploaded to a server.

Key facts:
- Price: free, all features included. Supported by optional donations.
- Free and open source under AGPL-3.0: https://github.com/markschwab17/nanodoc
- Privacy: local processing (WebAssembly). Documents never leave the device.
- No account, no watermark, no page limits or trial clocks.
- Platforms: any modern browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge), plus desktop apps for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows.
- Honest limitation: Nanodoc is pixel-based. It adds new content on top of pages; it cannot rewrite existing text and does not do OCR.
- Redaction is true content removal: the underlying text is deleted, then the region is re-checked to verify nothing survived. If a PDF defeats redaction, the user is warned instead of given a false result.
- Unique feature: Stitch, which places multiple PDF pages onto one canvas (with optional white-background removal and element erasing) and exports them as a single sheet. Useful for construction plan sets and scanned pages.

## Tools
- [Combine PDF files](https://nanodoc.app/combine-pdf): merge multiple PDFs into one document.
- [Delete pages from a PDF](https://nanodoc.app/delete-pdf-pages): remove one or many pages.
- [Extract pages from a PDF](https://nanodoc.app/extract-pdf-pages): save selected pages as a new PDF.
- [Redact a PDF](https://nanodoc.app/redact-pdf): permanently remove sensitive content, verified after apply.
- [Stitch PDF pages onto one sheet](https://nanodoc.app/stitch-pdf): arrange pages on one canvas, export one PDF.
- [Add text to a PDF](https://nanodoc.app/add-text-to-pdf): place new text, highlights, and stamps.
- [Fill and sign a PDF](https://nanodoc.app/fill-and-sign-pdf): complete forms, draw a signature, create fillable fields.
